title: client.trip_state (protocol v2)
description: Client -> server GPS sample in live mode, ~1 Hz from the tablet's location provider (PROTOCOL_v2.md, Navigation). Field names are exactly phase1's trip_state.jsonl line (docs/PHASE_1_UPSTREAM_DATA_CONTRACT.md 2.3) plus `type`, so the server hands the body to the phase1 route engine unchanged. Each sample is answered with one navigation.packet.

timestampMs.description: Unix epoch ms of the fix (Location.time / System.currentTimeMillis()). Must increase within a drive; a jump back of more than 60 s starts a new history on the server.

heading.description: Course over ground, degrees clockwise from north (Location.bearing). Send 0 when the fix has no bearing, as the phase1 android-collector does.
